key_insight: VFlash aims to make visual planning faster and more accurate by changing how models decode spatial primitives such as points, bounding boxes, and trajectories. Its Flash Primitive Decoding targets the overhead of generating coordinates one token at a time.
problem_solved: Autoregressive vision-language models generate visual plans sequentially, making richer spatial predictions increasingly costly for robotics and autonomous driving.
method: Represent spatial goals and anticipated motion using visual primitives rather than relying solely on language.
Introduce Flash Primitive Decoding to address coordinate-by-coordinate generation overhead.
The supplied abstract is truncated, so decoding mechanics and evaluation results are unavailable.
impact: More efficient visual-plan generation could help practitioners build responsive physical AI systems with richer spatial predictions. The supplied excerpt does not establish measured speedups or accuracy gains.
